blocks.h2: What Happens When You Call J. Blanton

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.body: Most toilet problems are cheap to fix. A new flapper, fill valve or wax seal costs far less than a new toilet. Replacement makes sense when the bowl or tank is cracked, when it clogs no matter what you do or when it's an older model that uses much more water per flush than today's toilets. If you're remodeling a Hanover Park bathroom anyway, a new toilet is an easy upgrade to add.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of Toilet Work
blocks.body: Small repairs are quick. Resetting a toilet or replacing a flange takes longer. A new toilet depends on the model you choose. Basement toilets that drain to an ejector pump may need a check of the pump too. We look first and quote a flat price.

blocks.h2: Toilet Questions From Hanover Park Homeowners

items.q: Why does my toilet keep running?
items.answer: Usually a worn flapper or fill valve.

items.q: Should I replace my old toilet?
items.preview: If it clogs often or uses a lot of water, it's worth considering.
items.answer: If it clogs often, cracks or uses a lot of water per flush, replacement is worth it.

items.preview: Loose bolts or a damaged flange.
items.answer: Loose bolts or a damaged flange. We fix it and reset the toilet.

items.q: Can you install a toilet I bought?
items.answer: Yes, with a new seal and supply line.

items.q: How do I know if my toilet is leaking?
items.answer: Add a few drops of food coloring to the tank. If color shows in the bowl without flushing, the flapper is leaking.

items.q: Can you fix a weak flush?
items.answer: Often. Clogged rim holes, a low water level or a worn flapper are the usual causes.

items.q: How much does toilet repair cost in Hanover Park?
items.preview: It depends on the problem. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on what's wrong and whether you're repairing or replacing. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
